name: events-calendar
title: Events Calendar
description: Interactive event calendar with month/week/day views and drag-and-drop rescheduling, themed to the app palette. Wraps react-big-calendar with localization and DnD preconfigured; all react-big-calendar props pass through. Use for event calendars, appointment schedulers, and time-slot views (NOT for date picking — that is the calendar component).
docs: Import { EventsCalendar, Event, Slot } from '@/components/ui/events-calendar'. Map DB rows (ISO strings) to Event objects with Date instances (start/end, optional allDay, resource for the source row). onSelectSlot receives { start, end } Dates for click-to-create; provide BOTH onEventDrop and onEventResize for drag edits. Set the height directly on the component (style={{ height: '700px' }}), no wrapper divs. Load the events-calendar skill for the full wiring recipe.

changelog.description: Drops the `@/lib/require-shim` import: the app's bundle resolves CommonJS `require` calls itself. Nothing changes in behaviour.
Brings the app's copy up to date and adds its version line.
